expects.query: Deploy the VSS **base** profile on {{platform}}, using the `/vss-deploy-test-openshell` skill end-to-end and autonomously. After the stack is healthy, follow `/vss-ask-video`: set `VSS_REPO_ROOT="${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}"`, validate `services/agent/pyproject.toml`, run `cd "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}" && uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss vlm run --help`, and record the deployment with `vss configure --base-url http://localhost:7777`. Do not POST to the agent `/generate` endpoint and do not hand-roll `/v1/chat/completions`.
checks: `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8000/health` returns exit 0 (Agent REST API responsive)

The project-local CLI is usable from the validated checkout: `cd "${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}" && uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss vlm run --help` returns exit 0. The `--extra cli` flag is required; a globally installed `vss` is not an acceptable substitute
The agent recorded the deployment against the ingress origin `http://localhost:7777` with `vss configure --base-url`
The agent does not POST to the VSS agent `/generate` endpoint and does not hand-roll an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` request
